Title: Verify login with a valid username and password
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1. Enter a valid username.
2. Enter a valid password.
3. Click the Login button.
Actual Result: The user successfully logs in and is redirected to the Dashboard.

Title: Verify login with a valid username and an invalid password
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1. Enter a valid username.
2. Enter an invalid password.
3. Click the Login button.
Expected Result: The user is not logged in and an error message is displayed.
Actual Result: The user is not logged in, A red "Invalid credentials" message is displayed.

Title: Verify login with an invalid username and a valid password
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1. Enter an invalid username.
2. Enter a valid password.
3. Click the Login button.
Expected Result: The user is not logged in and an error message is displayed.
Actual Result: The user is not logged in, A red "Invalid credentials" message is displayed.

Title: Verify login with an invalid username and password
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1. Enter an invalid username.
2. Enter an invalid password.
3. Click the Login button.
Expected Result: The user is not logged in and an error message is displayed.
Actual Result: The user is not logged in, A red "Invalid credentials" message is displayed.

Title: Verify login when the username and password fields are empty
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps: Click the login button without entering a username or password.
Expected Result: The user is not logged in and an error message is displayed.
Actual Result: The user is not logged in, "Required" is displayed under the empty field.

Title: Verify login when the username is empty and password is filled
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1.  Enter a valid password.
2.  Click the Login button without entering a username.
Expected Result: The user is not logged in and an error message is displayed.
Actual Result: The user is not logged in, "Required" is displayed under the empty field.

Title: Verify login when the username is filled and password is empty
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1.  Enter a valid username.
2. Click the Login button without entering a password.
Expected Result: The user is not logged in and an error message is displayed.
Actual Result: The user is not logged in, "Required" is displayed under the empty field.

Title: Verify login with a username using different letter cases
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1. Enter the username using a different letter case.
2. Enter a valid password.
3. Click the Login button.
Expected Result: Not specified in requirements (FND-001).Observed behavior is documented.
Actual Result: "ADMIN" was rejected with "Invalid credentials". The username is case-sensitive.

Title: Verify that the password field masks the entered characters
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Test Data: Username: Not required for this check          Password : admin123
Steps:
1. Enter a valid password in the Password field.
2. Observe the Password field.
Expected Result: The entered password characters are masked and are not displayed as plain text.
Actual Result: The password is displayed as dots.

Title: Verify that the system displays an error message when login fails
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1. Enter a valid username.
2. Enter an invalid password.
3. Click the Login button.
Expected Result: The user is not logged in and an error message is displayed.
Actual Result: The user is not logged in, A red "Invalid credentials" message is displayed.

Title: Verify that users can log out from their account
Preconditions: User is logged in and is on the Dashboard
Steps:
1. Click the user profile icon.
2. Click the Logout option.
Expected Result: The user is successfully logged out and redirected to the login page.
Actual Result: The user is successfully logged out and redirected to the login page.

Title: Verify that the user session ends after logout
Preconditions: User is logged in and is on the Dashboard
Steps:
1. Click the user profile icon.
2. Click the Logout option.
3. Try to open the Dashboard URL directly in the browser.
Expected Result: The user cannot access the Dashboard after logout and is redirected to the login page.
Actual Result: The user cannot access the Dashboard after logout and is redirected to the login page.

Title: Verify the browser Back button after logout
Preconditions: User is logged in and is on the Dashboard
Steps:
1. Click the user profile icon.
2. Click the Logout option.
3. Click the browser Back button.
Expected Result: The Dashboard is not displayed, and the user remains on or is redirected to the login page.
Actual Result: The Dashboard was displayed after logout via the Back button. Clicking any item redirected to the login page.
